quick: 1 tablet (etofylline 77 mg + theophylline 23 mg) two to three times daily
summary: Etofylline is a theophylline derivative used in India almost always with theophylline (etofylline 77 mg + theophylline 23 mg per tablet; injection etofylline 169.4 mg + theophylline 50.6 mg per 2 mL). It is not converted to theophylline, so the theophylline component sets the toxicity risk.
indications: Bronchospasm in asthma and COPD (in combination with theophylline)

dosage.d: 1 tablet (etofylline 77 mg + theophylline 23 mg) two to three times daily
dosage.n: SR tablet (etofylline 231 mg + theophylline 69 mg) once or twice daily

dosage.d: 1 ampoule (2 mL) by slow IV injection over at least 5 minutes, may repeat per response
dosage.n: Slow injection: rapid IV causes arrhythmia and seizures

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Phosphodiesterase inhibition and adenosine antagonism relax bronchial smooth muscle; weaker than theophylline.

relative: Heart failure, liver disease and the elderly (theophylline clearance reduced)

lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
hepatic: Reduce dose of the theophylline combination in hepatic impairment

major: Ciprofloxacin, erythromycin, clarithromycin, fluvoxamine, cimetidine: raise theophylline levels (toxicity)
moderate: Smoking, rifampicin, phenytoin, carbamazepine: lower theophylline levels

monitoring: Heart rate and symptoms of toxicity
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: Theophylline-type toxicity: activated charcoal (multiple dose), treat seizures and arrhythmias; haemodialysis in severe cases.
